It would be very handy if Google would let us link Keep items to Calendar entries, so changed made to my notes would automatically show up in the linked calendar meeting. title: So far the best Google app on iOS after Google Map
body:
Google official apps on the iOS were always a gift to users already trapped into the Google cloud ecosystem.

Google Map was stunning (especially comparing to Apple Mad). Mailbox was once innovative.. but not quite practical to my individual use. Gmail then replaced my native iOS Mail app, no doubt. Then, rest of the Google apps are no go.

Then, here comes the Keep. Very nice and easy to use. Even Apple tried harder (after many years!!) and revamped the native Reminder app, Keep is still slightly better in terms of practical usages.

There are tons of review on how Keep works, so details of he goods aren't need here. Just a feature req, can we have just a bit more text formatting in a simple memo? I don't need complex editor which may ruin the simplicity of the app, but maybe normal+bold? Or normal+highlight?

After all, thank you for giving us free and highly usable app for our everyday lives.
